execution_shape.description: Fragment / instance counts; Compare's parallelism gate reads only this.

execution_summary.description: Per-plan-node reading built with the official ExplainAnalyzer recipe.

graph_view.description: The single execution graph: plan nodes and their typed relations.

value.description: Base-10 only: JSON numbers are never used for counters.

fragment_count.description: Distinct `Fragment N:` sections; `None` when they can not be counted.

instance_count.description: Sum of every fragment's `InstanceNum`; `None` unless all are exact.

oneOf.description: Fragment count and every fragment's `InstanceNum` are exact.
Fragments are known but at least one `InstanceNum` is missing or invalid.

query_total_time.description: `Summary.Total` as reported by the FE; independent of operator time.

metric_id.description: A registered metric id of the finding's subject.

measurements.description: What the rule measured on its subject, in the rule's own terms (a skew ratio, a fan-out ratio, bytes sent, a time share). Empty when the rule publishes no measurement; the browser never derives one.

measurement_changes.description: Rule measurements of the findings named by `added`, `resolved`, `persisting` and `changed`, paired by `measurement_id`. Display text is copied from each side's `Finding.measurements`; the comparator does not compute a measurement delta. Absent in payloads older than v0.6.

partial_evidence.description: Entries from `resolved` or `added` (`rule_id:subject_ref`) whose finding or unique negative evaluation has partial evidence. The backend labels these explicitly; consumers must not infer this from the report state. Older comparisons omit this field and deserialize as an empty list.

FindingMeasurement.description: One value a rule evaluator computed from the typed inputs it compared. The text is formatted by the backend; bounded inputs give an interval.

input_refs.description: Metric cells (`MetricCell.metric_cell_ref`) the value was computed from.

operator_type.description: Physical operator the value belongs to when narrower than the plan node.

threshold_text.description: The rule's trigger condition on this value (e.g. `> 2×`); absent for context values that are not compared.

FindingMeasurementChange.description: One rule measurement of one finding entry, before and after.

baseline_display_text.description: `None` when that side has no such finding or the finding did not publish this measurement; never 0.

baseline_threshold_text.description: Each side's rule condition on this value. They differ when the two findings were triggered on different severity tiers of one rule.

finding_entry.description: The `FindingDelta` entry (`rule_id:subject_ref`) the measurement belongs to.

instance_num.description: FE `InstanceNum`; `None` when missing, ambiguous or invalid (never 0).

restates_edge_id.description: Set on a `fragment_sink` edge whose relation an explicit `plan_child` edge (exchange -> sending fragment root) already states in the opposite direction. A renderer draws the referenced edge and skips this one.

GraphSqlLocation.description: Request-local bounded source excerpt; never a reconstructed SQL expression.

edges.description: This remains source ordered; canonicalization never sorts these edges by ID.

nodes.description: This remains source ordered when the source relation is ordered.

HotspotTier.description: Official thresholds: share > 30% is most consuming, > 15% second. `Boundary` (product contract): the official reading and the text precision interval of the share disagree about one of those thresholds, so the tier is not decidable; the time-share rules report the same input as `suspected` at that boundary.

match_key.description: Structural identity of the counter inside its subject: physical operator (fragment, pipeline, type, plan node, operator id) plus the raw counter name, which separates base/MIN/MAX statistics. Present only when unique within the report, so Compare can pair it across two Profiles of one plan; absent means it can not be paired unambiguously.

bounds.description: Absolute-delta interval. This never carries percentage bounds.

percentage_bounds.description: Percentage-delta interval. This is independent from `bounds`.

time_share_basis_points.description: Share of `QueryCumulativeOperatorTime` in basis points (1/100 percent).

limitations.description: What the recommendation did not check (the finding's own limitations describe its measurement instead).

next_step.description: What to do first, in one sentence.

recommendation_id.description: Stable id of the recommendation text, e.g. `rec.scan.reduce_read@v1`.

result_effect.description: Whether a correct change is expected to keep the query result.

title.description: Short action title; the finding category names the problem instead.

oneOf.description: Points at where the cost is (time-share rules).
A concrete check for an observed signal (spill, skew, fan-out…).

evidence_refs.description: Exact metric cells (`MetricCell.metric_cell_ref`) of the finding's own subject that this step reads; empty when none is printed.

delta_ids.description: Delta ids from `version-deltas.json` that apply, in file order.

release_deltas.description: A release other than the pack's own: the pack read with the audited deltas of that release (multi-version source audit). Absent for the pack's own release.

line_refs.description: The line of every text source reference in the report, from the adapter's typed locator. Names a reference whose line text is outside the safe allowlist above, so the browser never parses a reference.

SummaryValue.description:
One backend-computed value. `Unavailable` never carries a number, so a missing metric can not be read as zero.

`Exact` means the value equals the official 3.5.14 `ANALYZE PROFILE` reading of the same Profile text (`RuntimeProfileParser` parses the printed counters too). When a counter was printed with less precision than the runtime value (e.g. `28.802ms` is truncated to the microsecond), `bounds` is the interval in `canonical_unit` that contains the runtime value; `None` means every input was printed losslessly.
